WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT home_store_id, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS nd,
       (SELECT max(join_date) FROM dim_member) AS max_join,
       (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AS rows_all_versions
FROM fv WHERE vn = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(home_store_id) ORDER BY 1

WITH per_member AS (
  SELECT member_id, min(join_date) AS jmin, max(join_date) AS jmax, min(valid_from) AS first_valid_from, count(*) AS versions
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM per_member WHERE jmin = DATE '2026-09-25') AS members_min_join,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM per_member WHERE jmin <> jmax) AS inconsistent_join,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM per_member WHERE jmin = DATE '2026-09-25' AND first_valid_from <> jmin) AS valid_from_mismatch,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AS stg_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE s.join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_id = s.member_id)) AS stg_not_in_dim,
  (SELECT string_agg(CAST(c AS VARCHAR), ',' ORDER BY d) FROM (SELECT join_date d, count(DISTINCT member_id) c FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-18' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1)) AS daily_counts_18sep_to_4oct
